title: The Chronicle of Theophanes Confessor: Byzantine and Near Eastern History, AD 284–813
author: Theophanes the Confessor

_quarry.citation: Mango, Cyril, and Roger Scott, trans. The Chronicle of Theophanes Confessor: Byzantine and Near Eastern History, AD 284–813. With Geoffrey Greatrex. Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1997.
_quarry.notes: Greek annalistic chronicle compiled at the Bithynian monastery of Megas Agros (~810–815), covering 284–813 CE in year-by-year entries. The Mango/Scott edition is the standard scholarly English translation with extensive annotation. Unique for the period 720–813 as the only continuous Greek narrative source and a major Christian source on the early Islamic caliphate.
